Title: Use Tough Tongue AI inside your Claude, Codex & Cursor : Tough Tongue AI Discussion Forums | Product Hunt
p/tough-tongue-ai-2. AI teammate for high-stakes conversations. # Use Tough Tongue AI inside your Claude, Codex & Cursor. We just shipped plugins, MCP, and skills for ToughTongue AI. **What this means:** Your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) can now create practice scenarios, refine them from real session data, and analyze team performance - without leaving the terminal. 1. Claude Code: claude plugin install toughtongue@toughtongue-skills. 2. Codex: codex plugin add toughtongue@toughtongue. 3. Cursor: Settings > Plugins > Import from Repo. * 4 skills: scenario-creator, scenario-refiner, session-analyst, and getting-started. * 26 MCP tools: scenarios, sessions, analytics, SIP calls, meeting bots, collections. **What you can actually do with this:**. * "Pull the last 3 lost deals from Gong and create a practice scenario for the pricing objection.". * "For the Enterprise Discovery Call scenario, pull the last 50 sessions. * "The onboarding agent ends calls too early. Pull the low-scoring sessions, diagnose, and fix.". * "I have a call with Sarah Chen in 30 minutes. Make me a practice scenario.". What workflows would you build with this? ### Replies. i appreciate the MCP tools. how flexible are custom workflows? user defined templates could make adoption much easier for different teams. @jason\_scott8 Very flexible, though user-defined templates are still an area we should explore more deeply. A lot of our users already create their own custom workflows, skills, and agent-writing patterns on top of our platform. I think the next step is giving them a cleaner way to package and reuse those patterns across teams. I’d also love to explore if anyone has formalized this well elsewhere. i would love to see more examples from customer support teams instead of only sales. could the same workflow improve onboarding and retention conversations? that seems like a natural expansion.
